messages.content: Write a nomination for an internal engineering award, for a team that improved the deployment process. Around 200 words.

output:
**Nomination: Platform Team — Deployment Process Overhaul**

I'm nominating the Platform team for their work rebuilding our deployment pipeline this quarter.

Six months ago, shipping a change meant a 45-minute build, a manual checklist, and someone on standby in case rollback was needed. Deploys happened on Tuesdays because nobody wanted to risk a Friday incident. The team rewrote the pipeline from the ground up: automated the checklist, added staged rollouts with real health checks, and cut build time to under eight minutes.

The result isn't just speed. We went from a handful of deploys a week to dozens a day, and rollback — when we need it — now takes seconds instead of a war room. Engineers ship fixes the same hour they find bugs. New hires push their first change in week one instead of week three.

What stands out is that they did this while keeping the system running for every other team. No freeze, no big-bang cutover — they migrated services one at a time and caught problems before they reached production.

This is the kind of infrastructure work that's easy to overlook because it makes everyone else's job quieter. Every team here ships faster because of it. I can't think of a group more deserving of recognition this cycle.
